hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southwestern Europe, Pyrenees mountains, on the border between France and Spain || rugged mountains dissected by narrow valleys || landlocked; straddles a number of important crossroads in the Pyrenees || Resources: hydropower, mineral water, timber, iron ore, lead || Exports: paintings, integrated circuits, cars, orthopedic appliances, garments (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: rugged mountains dissected by narrow valleys || Southwestern Europe, Pyrenees mountains, on the border between France and Spain

climate.excerpt: temperate; snowy, cold winters and warm, dry summers || avalanches

economy.excerpt: high GDP; low unemployment; non-EU Euro user; co-principality duty-free area between Spain and France; tourist hub but hit hard by COVID-19; modern, non-tax haven financial sector; looking for big tech investments; new member of SEPA and IMF || Exports: paintings, integrated circuits, cars, orthopedic appliances, garments (2023) || Industries: tourism (particularly skiing), banking, timber, furniture
